name: Molbio Diagnostics Ltd
tagline: India's only WHO-approved point-of-care molecular diagnostics platform (Truenat) - genuine IP moat, 31%+ revenue CAGR and margin-recovery guidance now evidenced in Q1 FY27 (24.6% vs 22.6% FY26), but a freshly-listed (Aug 2026) stock still on a rich ~59-60x TTM P/E with an unresolved net-debt/cash reconciliation
business_overview: Manufactures the Truenat platform - a portable, chip-based real-time PCR system for point-of-care molecular diagnostics (TB, COVID, HIV, dengue, and an expanding disease menu), the only Indian-made rapid molecular test WHO-approved for initial TB diagnosis after 13 years of in-house R&D. Sells devices plus a recurring razor-blade consumables (test-chip) model domestically and via export to ~140 countries (>12,500 devices installed across 90+ countries as of Mar-26). Six manufacturing facilities (Goa x2, Bengaluru, Visakhapatnam, Pune); installed capacity 5,400 devices/yr + 3.9 crore Truenat test kits/yr as of Mar-26. Listed via IPO in August 2026 (~Rs940 Cr raised, ~Rs200 Cr fresh issue for a new R&D facility + manufacturing automation + US/Europe expansion, rest OFS). Seeded via untrusted X triage (@nid_rockz, 2026-09-13).
fundamentals_table: FY24-FY26 revenue CAGR ~31.5% (Rs 837 Cr -> Rs 1,446 Cr); Q1 FY27 sales Rs 411 Cr (+309% YoY) - mostly a base effect off an anomalously weak, loss-making Jun-25 quarter (Rs 100 Cr sales); management flags the business as tender-driven and non-linear quarter to quarter
Net profit CAGR ~40.2% FY24-26 (Rs 83.5 Cr -> Rs 164.1 Cr); Q1 FY27 PAT Rs 58.75 Cr (+348% YoY off the same depressed base), PAT margin 14.3%

Gross borrowings roughly tripled to ~Rs 450 Cr in FY26 (from ~Rs 147 Cr FY25, ~Rs 184 Cr FY24); cash+short-term investments estimated ~Rs 370 Cr by one third-party source (not independently confirmed from a primary filing this pass) - implies mild NET DEBT (~Rs 80 Cr) rather than the net-cash position asserted by the prior pass; flagged as an open question
TTM P/E ~59-60x (screener.in, price ~Rs 1,288, 18-Sep-26), down from ~79x trailing P/E at listing as Q1 FY27's strong print entered trailing EPS - still rich
fundamentals_narrative: A genuine razor/razor-blade molecular-diagnostics compounder with real IP (WHO TB approval, ICMR certification) and an expanding disease-test menu. FY24-26 revenue CAGR ~31.5% and PAT CAGR ~40.2% are real, and the FY27 EBITDA-margin guidance of 24-25% is no longer just a promise - Q1 FY27 delivered 24.6%, up from FY26's dip to 22.6% (FY25 was 25.0%, pre-R&D-basis margin 28.6%). The eye-catching '309% YoY' Q1 FY27 revenue headline is largely a base-effect artifact: Q1 FY26 (Jun-25) was an anomalously weak quarter (Rs 100 Cr sales, OPM -16%, a net LOSS of Rs 24 Cr) reflecting the tender-driven, non-linear nature of public-health procurement that management itself flags (guides investors to assess annually, not quarterly). Gross borrowings roughly tripled to ~Rs 450 Cr in FY26 funding capacity expansion - this pass could NOT independently re-confirm the prior pass's claim of a clear net-CASH position; one third-party aggregator suggests cash+ST investments of only ~Rs 370 Cr as of Mar-26, implying mild net debt of ~Rs 80 Cr rather than net cash of -Rs 321 Cr. This is flagged as an open reconciliation question pending a primary-source balance sheet read (screener's summarized balance sheet doesn't itemize cash, and the relevant PDFs were not reliably fetchable this pass). Valuation has compressed from ~79x trailing P/E at listing to ~59-60x TTM as the strong Q1 print entered trailing earnings, but remains rich for a stock with barely two months of public trading history.
technical_read: Listed Aug 17 2026 at Rs 980 (+21% over Rs 807 issue price). Hit a 52-week/all-time high of Rs 1,686.50 on Sept 11 2026 (up ~75% in a month, ~35% in two sessions on heavy volume, 20% upper circuit) before pulling back ~18.5% over Sept 15-16 on profit-taking (no negative news identified) to ~Rs 1,230, then stabilised around ~Rs 1,288 by Sept 18. Still <5 weeks of public trading history - momentum-driven, no meaningful multi-year chart to read.

Web coverage is IPO/post-listing focused, generally positive on the technology moat and Q1 FY27 delivery, but consistently flagging valuation richness.
